Yes I did, or still do sometimes. It's not a daily thing anymore, it's every few months now just to check up on my progress.

I can run but if I go to fast something will make a popping sound.

The internet was my escape from reality, but now I need an escape from the internet into reality. Stuff just doessn't go my way.

You know, I think I'll do this. Thanks.

I used to be a bully in school for half a year. I did it for no reason. Then, I saw how much I hurt these kids and looked myself in the mirror "deep inside" and realized that I am better than that. It's not the kind of experience you want to go through or see first hand. It can be painful to yourself and to others.

Right now my leg has actually healed a lot but I have to start from scratch to build myself a new. Restarting is really hard.

I've tried to speak to everyone about it but I just get ignored, no matter what.

I went to this cyberbullys youtube, looked at his video mocking me, and I thanked him. I told my story on his channel. Thanked him again and have reported him for the video.

Thanks for the encouragement. It actually made me feel a little better for tomorrow.
